evals.prompt: This repo is at ./repo (an Express + Zod + React monorepo). Add a feature for listing an org's participants: a backend endpoint and a frontend page to view them. There's no participants module yet, but there's a working rooms module you can use as a reference for how this repo does things.
evals.expected_output: A new participants feature that matches the rooms module's conventions: a Zod schema in packages/shared-types (barrel-exported), a vertical-slice handler under apps/api/src/modules/participants/features/..., using Result<T,E> and req.membership.orgId (not a param/body id), plus a apps/web/src/features/participants/ hook+page going through the existing api-client.ts. Ask-First items (new deps) flagged, not silently added.
expectations: Reads the existing rooms module (schema, handler, repository, hook, page) before writing the participants feature
Adds a Participant Zod schema under packages/shared-types with a barrel export reachable from the root index.ts
Backend handler derives orgId from req.membership, not from a route param or request body
Backend handler returns a Result<T,E>-shaped value rather than throwing for expected failures
New backend feature lives under apps/api/src/modules/participants/features/... (vertical-slice), not a global controllers/dto/ folder
Frontend goes through apps/web/src/lib/api-client.ts rather than calling fetch directly
Frontend feature lives under apps/web/src/features/participants/ colocating a hook and a page
Does not introduce a new npm dependency without flagging it as Ask-First

evals.prompt: This repo is at ./repo (a Spring Boot backend + OpenAPI-generated shared client + TS frontend). Add an endpoint to fetch a single key's detail by id, and wire it into the frontend so KeysPage can show it. There's a working list-keys feature you can use as a reference.
evals.expected_output: A new endpoint added to api/openapi.yaml, a matching Controller/Service/Repository trio in backend following the existing layered (not vertical-slice) convention, using the Authentication principal for org scoping (not a path param), with the generated client regenerated/rebuilt before frontend consumes it through the existing api-client.ts wrapper -- not a raw fetch or a direct import of the generated client from a component.
expectations: Reads the existing list-keys Controller/Service/Repository trio before adding the new endpoint
Adds the new path to api/openapi.yaml as the source of truth for the contract
New backend code follows the layered convention (separate Controller/Service/Repository classes), not a vertical-slice folder
Controller derives orgId from the Authentication principal, not a path/query parameter
Frontend consumes the new endpoint through the existing api-client.ts wrapper, not a raw fetch or a direct import of the generated client into KeysPage
Notes that the shared client needs regenerating/rebuilding before the frontend sees the new method, rather than silently assuming it just works
Adds a colocated test under src/test/java mirroring the new class's package path
